response.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT AlbumId, UnitPrice, Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds AS bpm FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0), album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM valid GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS overall_avg_bpm FROM album_stats) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bpm, a.avg_bpm - o.overall_avg_bpm AS bpm_diff_from_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY bpm_diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
